newsitem.title: SWEDEN: BT Industries says bid for Raymond Corp complete.
newsitem.headline: BT Industries says bid for Raymond Corp complete.

text.p: Sweden's BT Industries AB, a materials handling company, said on Monday its cash bid for U.S. Raymond Corp for $33 per share had been approved by U.S. competition authorities.
"The U.S. Antitrust authorities have no objections towards BT Industries' acquisition of Raymond Corp of the United States," BT Industries said in a statement.
It said the board of Raymond Corp. unanimously recommended the bid and that at the end of the tender offer more than 90 percent of shareholders had accepted it.
"With this it is a done deal," BT Industries managing director Carl-Erik Ridderstrale said in the statement.
BT Industries makes motorised warehouse equipment such as forklifts, as does Raymond Corp.
